title: The Spitfire Grill
description: A small-town businessman sends his mousy wife (Marcia Gay Harden) to watch the ex-convict waitress (Alison Elliott) running the local diner for her bedridden boss (Ellen Burstyn).

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: Lost & Found
description: To spend time with an attractive neighbor (Sophie Marceau), a man (David Spade) kidnaps her dog, which proceeds to swallow a valuable ring.

title: Lost in Space
description: Villains complicate a family's (William Hurt, Mimi Rogers, Heather Graham) 2058 spaceship journey to a distant habitable planet.

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Revolution
description: A trapper (Al Pacino) joins the fight against the British in 1776 after his teenage son is tortured by a redcoat (Donald Sutherland).

title: Night Shift
description: A meek man (Henry Winkler), his helper (Michael Keaton) and a hooker (Shelley Long) run a call-girl ring from the city morgue.

title: My Blue Heaven
description: Slick mob witness Vinnie (Steve Martin) hides out in suburbia with square FBI man Barney (Rick Moranis).

title: Best Friends
description: Hollywood screenwriters (Burt Reynolds, Goldie Hawn), happy as lovers, unwisely get married and go east to meet their in-laws.

title: With Honors
description: The sole copy of a 100-page thesis falls into the hands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) who uses it to blackmail a Harvard student (Brendan Fraser).

title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: 8 Seconds
description: Lane Frost is a cowboy who rises to become a professional bull-riding champion in the 1980s. Along the way, he endures injuries and the ups and downs of married life.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: One Crazy Summer
description: A budding cartoonist (John Cusack) helps a singer (Demi Moore) save her family home from a land developer on the island of Nantucket.

title: Alien Autopsy
description: In the 1990s two men (Ant McPartlin, Declan Donnelly) produce a fake video that purports to be footage of an alien autopsy.

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Forget Paris
description: Friends at a restaurant recall the romance of a yuppie couple (Billy Crystal, Debra Winger) who met in Paris four years before.

title: The Informant!
description: FBI agents receive an unpleasant surprise when they rely on ADM executive Mark Whitacre to gather evidence in their price-fixing case against agribusiness giant Archer Daniels Midland.

title: Over the Edge
description: A heroin addict sees a body fall past his window and goes outside to investigate.

title: Lady in the Water
description: A building manager rescues an enigmatic young woman and learns that she is a "narf," a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Frequency
description: Thirty years after the death of his father, a police officer is stunned to find himself communicating with him thanks to an old ham radio.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: Salvagers (Michael Caine, Sally Field) seeking cash and a madman (Telly Savalas) seeking plutonium are trapped with survivors in an upside-down ocean liner.

title: Singles
description: A group of young adults in a Seattle apartment building faces a series of romantic crises and catastrophes.

title: New York Minute
description: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).

title: Malice
description: Married New Englanders (Nicole Kidman, Bill Pullman) rent the third floor of their home to a suave surgeon (Alec Baldwin) who gets too close.

title: Vision Quest
description: A teenage wrestler (Matthew Modine) has trouble focusing on his training regimen when a worldly drifter (Linda Fiorentino) takes up temporary residence at his home.

title: Caddyshack II
description: The snobby president (Robert Stack) of a country club tees off with a self-made man (Jackie Mason) whose daughter wants to join.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
description: Two overbearing mothers try to help their daughters win a beauty contest for the title of Dairy Queen.

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: A Prairie Home Companion
description: The creator (Garrison Keillor) of a long-running radio show conducts business as usual while his guests, cast and crew (Meryl Streep, Lindsay Lohan, Kevin Kline) prepare for the final broadcast.

title: My Giant
description: A sleazy showbiz agent (Billy Crystal) tries to exploit a very large, gentle man (Gheorghe Muresan) he discovered in a Romanian monastery.

title: Sweet November
description: A workaholic executive (Keanu Reeves) and an unconventional woman (Charlize Theron) agree to a personal relationship for a trial period of one month.

title: No Reservations
description: A career-centered chef (Catherine Zeta-Jones) faces important changes in her life when she becomes her young niece's guardian and crosses forks with a brash employee in her kitchen.

title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
description: A CIA operative goes undercover to find a former agent selling nuclear secrets to the Russians.

title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: Beautiful Creatures
description: Teens (Alden Ehrenreich, Alice Englert) in a backwater Southern town encounter a history of family secrets and a curse that looms for one as she approaches her 16th birthday.
